text: Who are the best luxury real estate agencies in Brisbane? Give me a shortlist of specific prestige property agencies with reasons.

result.keyword: Who are the best luxury real estate agencies in Brisbane? Give me a shortlist of specific prestige property agencies with reasons.

items.markdown:
Brisbane's top luxury real estate agencies include **Queensland Sotheby's International Realty**, **Place Estate Agents (New Farm / Ascot)** , and **Belle Property (Ascot / West End)** . These prestige specialists dominate the city's riverfront and inner-city luxury market through global reach, high-record sales, and tailored marketing.[[1]](https://queenslandsothebysrealty.com/)[[2]](https://www.eplace.com.au/brisbanes-luxury-agent)[[3]](https://www.belleproperty.com/west-end)

### Shortlist of Prestige Property Agencies

- **Queensland Sotheby's International Realty** 
	- **Core Strength:** Global luxury network and high-end international marketing.
	- **Why They Excel:** Ideal for ultra-prime residential estates and riverfront mansions. They connect local Brisbane sellers to an extensive international database of high-net-worth buyers across more than 70 countries.[[1]](https://queenslandsothebysrealty.com/)
- **Place Estate Agents (New Farm & Ascot)** 
	- **Core Strength:** Dominance in Brisbane’s inner-north prestige and riverfront postcodes.
	- **Why They Excel:** Led by prominent high-end specialists like Sarah Hackett, Place holds some of Brisbane’s highest record-breaking per-square-meter and riverfront sales, combining heavy local PR with deep data analytics.[[1]](https://www.eplace.com.au/brisbanes-luxury-agent)
- **Ray White (Ascot / New Farm Prestige)** 
	- **Core Strength:** Market share, auction power, and high-volume luxury campaigns.
	- **Why They Excel:** Backed by a massive brand footprint, their dedicated prestige teams regularly handle landmark heritage homes, contemporary architectural builds, and luxury penthouses in suburbs like Hamilton, Ascot, and New Farm.
- **Belle Property (Ascot & West End)** 
	- **Core Strength:** Boutique high-end presentation and boutique client service.
	- **Why They Excel:** Known for refined styling, strong inner-south and inner-north reach, and exceptional customer satisfaction ratings, making them a go-to for design-forward luxury homes and character properties.[[1]](https://www.belleproperty.com/west-end)

### Comparative Overview

| Agency | Primary Prestige Focus | Key Differentiator |
|---|---|---|
| **Queensland Sotheby's** | Ultra-luxury & Riverfront | Global buyer network & prestige branding |
| **Place Estate Agents** | New Farm, Ascot, Riverfront | Record-setting local sales & deep data |
| **Ray White Prestige** | Inner-City & Acreage | High-velocity auction campaigns & reach |
| **Belle Property** | Inner-North & Inner-South | Boutique styling & client care |
